headline: HDFCBANK delivered on advance growth expectations for Q1-FY26, with credit cost remaining stable and asset quality maintaining its healthy position.

segments.Whole Bank: Credit costs remained stable excluding agriculture, as guided, but NPA levels showed a slight increase from the previous quarter. Advance growth was in line with guidance at 12%, higher than the system growth rate of 5.4% to 10.5%. CASA ratio and deposit growth were strong, reflecting management's focus on granular deposits.
segments.Retail: Retail share of advances increased, contributing to overall growth momentum.

keyThemes: Healthy asset quality with continued focus on granular deposits
Strong advance growth above system growth rate
